fit_to_observed_gap: Directly targets the failure mode seen in AgentDebugX: separating an upstream decisive action from downstream tool/verifier symptoms.
critical_constraint: Attribution requires a real resample/re-execution policy for the intervened step. Supplying the known correct answer as a synthetic resampler would make the test circular and is forbidden.
admissible_test: Use a Brain path whose original executable policy is available and replayable; freeze factual failure before attribution; require culprit localization without encoding the expected culprit into the resample policy.
